jd_text:
Machine Learning Engineer - Computer Vision, Bengaluru

We are looking for an ML Engineer with 3+ years of experience to build and deploy
computer vision models in production.

Must have:
- Strong Python and PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Deep learning for image classification, detection and segmentation
- Experience with OpenCV and image preprocessing pipelines
- Model training at scale on GPU clusters
- MLflow or comparable experiment tracking
- Deploying models with TorchServe, Triton or similar

Good to have:
- Kubeflow, Airflow for ML pipelines
- ONNX and model quantisation for edge deployment
- Published research or Kaggle competition results

Responsibilities:
- Train, evaluate and ship vision models to production
- Build annotation and data pipelines
- Monitor model drift and retrain
- Work with product to define model success metrics
